result.summary: Adds a GetUnbroadcastTxCount() accessor to the mempool and calls it from getmempoolinfo instead of copying the unbroadcast transaction ID set. This avoids heap allocations and set copying under lock solely to count entries.
result.problem: getmempoolinfo calls GetUnbroadcastTxs().size(), which returns the unbroadcast transaction ID set by value. When the set contains transactions, this unnecessarily copies the container under the mempool lock only to discard it immediately after reading its size.
evidence: Author benchmark on Apple M5 shows GetUnbroadcastTxs().size() execution time grows linearly from 25 ns at 0 IDs to ~908 µs at 10,000 IDs, whereas GetUnbroadcastTxCount() remains flat at ~22.6 ns (PR description).
result.scope_notes: Small patch (+8/-1 across 2 files); the diff itself was omitted from the input.
result.card: Adds a GetUnbroadcastTxCount() accessor to avoid copying the entire unbroadcast transaction set by value in getmempoolinfo. Previously, reading unbroadcastcount via GetUnbroadcastTxs().size() copied all unbroadcast IDs under lock and discarded them immediately after. The author's microbenchmarks show query time increasing from 25 ns with zero IDs up to ~0.9 ms with 10,000 IDs for the copy approach, compared to a constant ~22.6 ns with the direct count accessor.

risk.why: A flaw in the new accessor could report an incorrect unbroadcast transaction count in getmempoolinfo.
